::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru firm founded 2005 out of its founders' research at IISc (CEO Deepak Shapeti, CTO Dr Ranjani Narayan; Prof S.K. Nandy of IISc as mentor). Its MuDRA-1 test chip — 16 RISC-V cores on the REDEFINE architecture, TSMC 28nm — taped out and was unveiled at SEMICON India in September 2026; bring-up is pending and commercial MuDRA is planned for late 2027.
:::

## What does this firm design?

REDEFINE many-core reconfigurable processors with dynamic scheduling, delivered as SoCs, IP and accelerator cards for AI and signal-processing workloads.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Many-core reconfigurable REDEFINE processors for AI and signal processing.
- **IP ownership 5/5:** Own REDEFINE reconfigurable architecture, rooted in founders' IISc research.
- **Design completeness 3/5:** MuDRA-1 test chip taped out on TSMC 28nm; bring-up still pending.
- **Market readiness 2/5:** Test chip only; commercial MuDRA planned for late 2027.
